Whatever form it takes, shields are carried by warriors of all races.

fields.name: Weapons of War

content.value: Across the grim and dangerous Old World and beyond, warriors employ many different types of weapons against a multitude of foes. From the well-wrought axes of the Dwarfs to the less-sophisticated choppas of the Orcs, every race has its favoured weapons.
It is usual for all the models in a unit to carry the same weapons. It is acceptable for models belonging to the command group to be differently armed for the sake of identification.

From the well-wrought axes of the Dwarfs to the less-sophisticated choppas of the Orcs, every race has its favoured weapons. It is usual for all the models in a unit to carry the same weapons. It is acceptable for models belonging to the command group to be differently armed for the sake of identification.

Although in some cases a model will have an armour value given, the armour value of most models is determined by their equipment. The most common types of armour are: Type of Armour Armour Value Light armour 6+ Heavy armour 5+ Full plate armour 4+

content.value: by 1. For example, a model equipped with light armour has an armour value of 6+. Should that model also carry a shield, its armour value would be improved by 1 by lowering the target number from 6+ to 5+.
Note that if a model uses a weapon that has the Requires Two Hands special rule in combat, it cannot also use a shield.
